[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After using this facial cleanser consistently for a month now, I can safely say that it has transformed my skincare routine. Every time I use it my skin feels incredibly soft and plump, almost like after a mini facial. It has reduced the appearance of my blackheads and pores, all while ensuring there's no damage to my skin barrier, and it remains intact and healthy. avis.titre: Not A Holy Grail - But Close
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have to preface here- this cleanser is definitely one of the higher performing ones I have tried, which means a lot coming from someone who has combination, acne prone, sensitive skin. Despite having exfoliating beads in it, not once did I feel like my skin was being stripped, nor did I have irritation. My face felt sufficiently clean after I rinsed the cleanser off my face without feeling totally like a sahara desert. But if you are expecting nourished, baby soft, smooth and moisturized as if the cleanser had oils in it, you will not be getting that. That being said, you can still use this cleanser daily without running into problems. Nourished skin wasn't an issue for me as I still expect to put on either a moisturizer directly after this or continue with a rigorous skincare routine depending on how I continued to trial this (as I was doing separate tests since May to give this cleanser my full efforts in an honest attempt to review it fairly). In addition, no matter what I put on face afterwards, I had no complications. Thus, I would say that the cleanser overall is very safe to pair with most products. None of the ingredients made my skin freak out whatsoever, either. The formulation was very gentle on my skin and it lathers very well. A little goes an incredibly long way and the bottle I can see lasting an incredibly long time for the price point. The pump was nice and I had no problems with dispensing product.
